'''Novanian grog''' was an expensive [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverage from [[Ban-Satir II]], produced on the north side of the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] isle of [[N'van]].
{{Food-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]'' and ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' used the alternate spelling of '''Norvanian grog'''.
